about: Recorded brain turns for the scripted project-routing test (tests/fake_brain.py, S-06.6; the mention case, S-18.2; the kickoff case, S-20.1). Each replay is what the brain does for one eval case in skills/evals/brain-routing.json, following the orchestrate skill. `skill_says` are the rules the turn relies on: the fake claude refuses to replay when the skill it is given no longer says them. `calls` go, in order, through the real tools server to an in-process hub.

skill_says: Before every `tasks_spawn`, call `projects_list` and pick the project
